purpose: The file manager of the early console (plan step C4.2, ADR 0027): Arlecchino.Commander, MIT, Midnight Commander's layout on the Arlecchino framework, as a base application of the data volume's layer with the command arlc. Its releases are NativeAOT binaries of Linux, macOS and Windows alone, so the layer builds it from its source with the Arlecchino submodule by the stock SDK as a portable application without AOT, unchanged: the commit of 2026-09-19 after the release v2026.9.2, versioned by its date, since that release names a commit of the Arlecchino submodule its repository no longer holds (the library's history was rewritten) while this one takes the library's release v2026.9.3; on WitOS it falls back to pipes for commands (no pseudo-terminal), to polling for folder changes (no inotify) and to no trash, as its code does for an operating system it does not know, and runs commands through SHELL, which is PowerShell.
